z-m-39-01.title: Mitengo yakasiyana inogona kuva nepundutso imwechete here?
z-m-39-01.topic: Zvinoreva function ne one-to-one functions: mamiriro epundutso yemitengo nehukuru hwe codomain
z-m-39-01.goal: Shandisa counterexample kusimbisa kuti zvinoreva one-to-one function (ma elements akasiyana anoenderana nemitengo yakasiyana) hazvitauri chinhu nezvemapundutso emitengo, uye utsanangure kuti kana function ine mamiriro akafanana ipo zvinoenderana ne codomain.
z-m-39-01.material: Funga function f kubva padomain X={1, 2, 3, 4} kuenda kucodomain Y={1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7} setafura yemitengo. Tafura inonyora chete f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4) (hapana fomula). Mamiriro (가): f i one-to-one function, ndiko kuti, ma elements akasiyana e X anoenderana nemitengo yakasiyana. Mamiriro (나): f(1)+f(4)=f(2)+f(3). Mina akati, “Kana i one-to-one, mitengo mina yese yakasiyana. Ipapo mapundutso emapeya maviri haagone kuenzana sezvinoita mu (나).”
z-m-39-01.thinking.0: Kuendesa chirevo mutafura yemitengo uye kuchiedza
z-m-39-01.thinking.1: Kuvaka mienzaniso yakasiyana (ma counterexamples) inogutsa mamiriro
z-m-39-01.thinking.2: Kutonga nemamiriro kana function yakadai ichivapo kana codomain ichichinja
z-m-39-01.prereq.0: Zvinoreva function, domain, codomain, ne range, uye zvinoreva one-to-one function (chikamu chekutanga cheyuniti yema functions yeCommon Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro)
z-m-39-01.prereq.2: (Fungidziro yekutevedzana kwechikoro: H2 yebasa iri i label yekuoma yakapiwa pakugadzira, uye tinofungidzira kuti zvinodiwa zviri pamusoro zvakadzidzwa kare.)
z-m-39-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwako kwekutanga kwechirevo chaMina. (Hausati wadikanwa kuverenga.)
z-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.0: Funga f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4) semaburanki mana, uye uzadze nhamba mana dzakasiyana.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nenhamba dzawazadza, nyora f(1)+f(4) ne f(2)+f(3) zvakasiyana uye uenzanise kana dzakaenzana.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.a: Chokwadi. Kana mitengo mina yese yakasiyana, mapundutso emapeya maviri anosiyanawo
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.a: Uri kutora “mitengo yakasiyana” ne “mapundutso akasiyana” sechirevo chimwechete. Sarudza iwe pachako mapeya maviri akasiyana enhamba uye uenzanise mapundutso.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.b: Chokwadi. One-to-one function inokura sezvo x ichikura, saka mapundutso haagone kuenzana
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.b: Uri kutora one-to-one function ne increasing function sezvakafanana. Funga kana pane one-to-one functions ane mitengo inodzikira.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.c: Kwete. Kunyangwe mitengo yese yakasiyana, mapundutso emapeya maviri akasiyana anogona kuenzana
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.c: Waverenga chirevo se “nguva dzose” uye wakakahadzika kana pane muenzaniso. Zvino nguva yekuedza kana muenzaniso wakadai unogona kuvakwa chaizvo.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.d: Hatigone kutonga. Nekuti fomula ye f haina kupiwa
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.d: Uri kufunga function se fomula chete. Pano, tafura yemitengo mina bedzi inokwana kuedza mamiriro.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.explain: Mamiriro ekuva one-to-one function anoti chete kuti mitengo mina yakasiyana. Kana mapundutso emapeya maviri anogona kuenzana kunyangwe mitengo mina yakasiyana kunofanira kutariswa nekutsvaga muenzaniso chaizvo. Ngatiedzei munhanho inotevera.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.prompt: Uchishandisa tafura yemitengo, vaka ma functions f 2 anogutsa mamiriro ese (가) ne (나) uye ane f(1) hombe kupfuura f(2). Ma functions maviri anofanira kushandisa maseti emitengo akasiyana. (a=f(1), b=f(2), c=f(3), d=f(4); dzose i integers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 7)
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga watsvaga boka renhamba mina dzakasiyana apo f(1)+f(4) ne f(2)+f(3) dzakaenzana.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isa nhamba mina dzawakawana kuti f(1) ive hombe kupfuura f(2), uye utarise zvakare kuti mapundutso maviri achiri akaenzana.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.2: Tsvaga rimwe boka rine nhamba dzakasiyana nedzakashandiswa mu function yekutanga.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Mitengo mina yese i ma elements e codomain Y (integers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 7).
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Mutengo wese unofanira kuva integer kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 7.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Mitengo mina yese yakasiyana, saka i one-to-one function.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Mutengo mumwechete wakashandiswa kaviri. Haisi one-to-one function.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, (3, 1, 6, 4) ine 3+4=7=1+6 uye mitengo mina yese yakasiyana. Saka chirevo chaMina hachishande. Uyewo, sezvo pane muenzaniso une f(1)>f(2), one-to-one function haingoendi chete kumitengo inokura. ((1, 2, 3, 4) inogutsa mamiriro epundutso asi inoparadza f(1)>f(2), saka haigamuchirwe panhanho iyi.)
z-m-39-01.s.s3.prompt: Ruzivo rutsva: domain inoramba i X={1, 2, 3, 4} uye mamiriro (가) ne (나) anoramba akafanana, asi codomain Y yachinjwa sezvakaratidzwa pazasi. Sarudza ma codomains ese apo function f inogutsa mamiriro inogona kugadzirwa. (Hapana mamiriro f(1)>f(2).)
z-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.0: Mu codomain imwe neimwe, sarudza nhamba mina dzakasiyana, ipatsanure kuita mapeya maviri, uye unyore mapundutso emapeya maviri padivi pedivi.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kana codomain ine ma elements mashoma kupfuura 4, tanga wavaverenga kuti uone kana one-to-one function ichigona kugadzirwa chose.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.a: Zvinoratidzika kuti wakafunga kuti kuva ne ma elements 5 kwakakwana. Sarudza mana ayo, ayapatsanure kuita mapeya maviri, uye unyore iwe pachako kana pane chiitiko apo mapundutso akaenzana.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakatarisa kwete chete nhamba yema elements asiwo chokwadi chekuti nhamba dzakaenzana muhukuru. Tarisa kana wakawana mapeya maviri ane mapundutso akaenzana.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.c: Kana ukatarisa mamiriro epundutso kutanga, zviri nyore kusiya kuti ma elements haana kukwana. Tanga waverenga kuti mitengo mingani inodiwa kuti ive one-to-one function.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.d: Wakatarisa kana codomain yehukuru hwakafanana ne domain ine mapeya maviri ane mapundutso akaenzana. Wakafunga chiitiko apo nhamba mina dzese dzinoshandiswa.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.explain: {1,2,3} ine ma elements 3 chete, saka ma elements mana e X haagone kuva nemitengo yakasiyana, uye hapana one-to-one function chose. {1,2,3,4} ine 1+4=2+3, uye {2,5,8,11,14} ine mapeya maviri ane mapundutso akaenzana sa 2+14=5+11. {1,2,4,8,16} ine ma elements 5, asi hapana chiitiko apo mapundutso emapeya maviri akasiyana akaenzana. Hazvisi kuti kuva nema elements mazhinji kunokwana; nhamba dzipi ndizvo zvinokosha.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.prompt: Tsanangurira Mina. Nyora (1) kuti chirevo chekutanga chakaipa kupi, nemuenzaniso wenhamba, uye (2) kuti function ine mamiriro akafanana haigare iripo, uchishandisa codomain.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.hint.0: Tora imwe yematafura awakagadzira munhanho 2 sezvayakaita, uye unyore mitengo mina nemapundutso maviri.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.hint.1: Sarudza codomain imwe yausina kusarudza munhanho 3, uye unyore mumutsetse mumwe kuti nei function isina kugona kugadzirwa ne codomain iyoyo.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Mumuenzaniso wako wenhamba, zvakajeka here kuti mitengo mina yese yakasiyana uye mapundutso emapeya maviri akaenzana?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Wakapatsanura zvinotaurwa ne “one-to-one” nezvisingataurwi nayo here?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Wakapa mienzaniso (chiitiko chine ma elements mashoma, kana chiitiko chisina mapeya ane mapundutso akaenzana) inoratidza kuti zvichienderana ne codomain function inogona kuvapo kana kusavapo here?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.model.0: Mitengo mina yakasiyana inogona kuva nemapundutso akaenzana. Semuenzaniso, kana f(1)=3, f(2)=1, f(3)=6, f(4)=4, saka mitengo yese yakasiyana uye 3+4=1+6=7. Asi kana codomain i seti sa {1, 2, 4, 8, 16}, isina mapeya maviri ane mapundutso akaenzana, function yakadai haigone kugadzirwa.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.model.1: One-to-one function inoreva chete kuti mitengo haipindirani; haireve kuti mapundutso akasiyana. Kana f(1)=2, f(2)=1, f(3)=4, f(4)=3, saka 2+3=1+4=5, saka mapundutso akaenzana. Asi kana codomain ine ma elements 3 chete, hapana kunyange one-to-one function, saka zvichienderana neseti iri codomain, function inogona kuvapo kana kusavapo.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Haina kutaura kana mitengo ichikura, asi ine counterexample nemamiriro e codomain zvose.
